description: Agent Automotive: submit a service or repair invoice with the estimate and the service record: the invoice with the shop, invoice number, VIN, day invoiced, mileage, currency, each line with its id, kind (labor, part, fee or other), the work or part as described, part number, quantity, amount and the estimate line it bills, and its total; optionally the estimate with its number, VIN, day, currency, each line with the same fields, its total and the approved total; and optionally the service record with the VIN and each item of work performed with its id, description and part number. The signed report gives the invoice, the estimate and the record, the VIN across them, each billed line matched to its estimate line, the lines unestimated, billed above the estimate, billed with another part, not shown performed or left unbilled, the recorded work left off, and the totals against their lines and the approved estimate, and counts them, and names a divergent invoice: a billed line the estimate does not show, a line above its estimate, another part number than the estimate names, a billed line the service record does not show performed, an invoice total unlike its lines or above the approved estimate, and another VIN; then another quantity, an estimated line left off, recorded work left off the invoice and an estimate total unlike its lines, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No estimate, no service record, or no VIN on the invoice or beside it leaves the invoice unverified. Lines meet by the estimate line they name, then by part number, then by the work described; amounts compare to the cent. This reads vehicle service paperwork for one VIN: wever_warranty-check reads a warranty claim against the warranty terms for any product, vehicles included, and warranty claims stay there; wever_invoice-check reads an invoice against the job or mandate it claims to belong to; and wever_approval-version-check reads whether an approval still covers a changed document, while the service check reads the work, parts and amounts billed against the estimate and the work recorded. Verdict auto_service_divergent, auto_service_partial, auto_service_unverified or auto_service_consistent. POST /api/auto-service-check. Reads the vehicle paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no mechanical diagnosis, safety judgment, vehicle valuation or legal advice on title, registration or lease terms, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Automotive reads supplied vehicle paperwork for consistency between documents, each document identified by its VIN: a vehicle listing, a title, an odometer statement, a service or repair invoice, an inspection report, a recall completion record, a registration and a vehicle lease. Beside it, wever_warranty-check reads a warranty claim against the warranty terms for any product, vehicles included, for DiligenceOps, and warranty claims stay there; the Agent Real Estate checks read property documents identified by parcel and address, not vehicle documents; the Agent Insurance checks such as wever_insurance-coverage-check read insurance policies, vehicle policies included, and coverage terms stay there; and wever_logistics-carrier-check reads a shipping carrier’s billed charges and terms, not a car, and shares only the letters. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-automotive-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-automotive/.
